verdict.rationale: Otter's own launch blog claims "fully customizable" AI meeting summaries that extract insights "based on meeting purpose" and for roles such as sales, which directly addresses shaping notes by meeting type. However, this rests on one marketing sentence with no documentation of how templates or saved prompts are created, edited or assigned to meeting types. missing for 10: documented template or saved-prompt creation and editing, a mechanism to map templates to specific meeting types (discovery call, 1:1, standup), examples of template output, and independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Otter's fully customizable, AI-powered meeting summaries automatically extract actionable insights based on meeting purpose and for different functional roles, such as sales, recruiters, project managers
